name: CLOTHES-BREATHE-the-heat-never-halves
old: if (natural > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.trunc(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));

name: CLOTHES-BREATHE-the-threshold-at-ten
old: if (natural > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.trunc(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));
new: if (natural >= CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.trunc(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));
why: EQUIVALENT since AUDIT TEMP-UI E7: the half eases in from the line (warmth less the degrees past ten), so at ten itself it gives up nothing whether the test is > or >= - the threshold is continuous now, which is what E7 was for

name: CLOTHES-BREATHE-the-half-rounds-up
old: if (natural > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.trunc(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));
new: if (natural > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.ceil(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));

name: CLOTHES-BREATHE-the-cold-halves-too
old: if (natural > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.trunc(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));
new: if (Math.abs(natural) > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE) warmth = Math.max(Math.trunc(warmth / 2) - shade, warmth - (natural - CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE));

name: CLOTHES-BREATHE-the-wet-before-the-half
CLOTHES-BREATHE-the-dry-reading-unhalved
CLOTHES-BREATHE-armour-breathes-too
old: const warmth = warm > 0 ? Math.max(0, warm - Math.min(wet, WET_MAX)) : 0;
new: const warmth = warm > 0 ? Math.max(0, (natural > CLOTHES_BREATHE_ABOVE ? Math.trunc(warm / 2) : warm) - Math.min(wet, WET_MAX)) : 0;
